private_material: Exact numerical resolution, thresholds and scenario answers remain in the facilitator guide and engine; purchased player handouts reveal qualitative conditions.

checks.author_edits_preserved: Opening, seating, settlement and debrief match latest native author revision exactly; author removal of worked example preserved.
checks.component_transfer: Original sections 6–8 and 10 retained verbatim apart from section numbering. Section 9 retained in the Ascendant brief with heading hierarchy adjusted.
checks.phase_integration: Recording instructions and defaults occur in the phase where used; no separate Decision sheets section.
checks.native_readback: All four documents read back and captured after edits.
checks.faction_access: Teammates only; Ascendant visits after one irrevocable prophecy/NONE choice. No current plans disclosed before choice.
checks.vision_window: All four private answers retain their consequences; councils-only covers; unlocked assignments/reserve remain open during visits, orders/Warrant later. See docs/vision-timing-audit.txt.
checks.council_tables: No visits or messages between councils. Ascendant stays at Security and gives any Navigation decision to the facilitator at the deadline. Working sheets stay at each table; both final orders revealed together.
checks.player_information: Qualitative assets/orders/visions; all three tracks described at 0–4. Exact operation effects moved to facilitator procedure. Requirements, authority, duties and settlement stay public.

limitations: The map records editorial coverage, not proof of comprehension or a new playtest. Prior Playtrace evidence retains the source revisions used for that run.
setting_change: Sorenne’s Fall and the Sorenne Flag replace generic civilian and remnant descriptions. Stability retains the former Communities arithmetic; it measures supply and civil services, not political loyalty.
